stemMd: What does the final sentence emphasize?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Meeting a technical target does not always complete the user’s goal.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Ventilation systems are always incompatible with lectures.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Technical targets should never be used.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Only front-row students matter in design.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Users’ reports always override every physical observation.

explanationMd: The case separates a successful change in reverberation from complete speech intelligibility. It encourages evaluating the wider goal as well as the chosen metric. It does not reject measurement itself.

distractorRationale.e: The engineers combine reports with measurements.
distractorRationale.b: The case concerns one unit’s noise, not every system.
distractorRationale.d: The investigation responds to rear-seat difficulty.
